user.title: Create a heating profile
user.description: A thermostat-like device with a day and a night temperature range for one room. Under Configure it can also drive an air conditioner to keep that range.

set_profile.name: Set profile
set_profile.description: Changes the day/night temperature ranges and start times of a heating profile.

day_temperature.name: Day minimum
day_temperature.description: Lowest temperature during the day; heating aims for it.

day_temperature_high.name: Day maximum
day_temperature_high.description: Highest temperature during the day; cooling aims for it.

night_temperature.name: Night minimum
night_temperature.description: Lowest temperature during the night; heating aims for it.

night_temperature_high.name: Night maximum
night_temperature_high.description: Highest temperature during the night; cooling aims for it.

init.title: Climate control: sources
init.description: Choose a room temperature sensor and an air conditioner to let this profile drive the AC. Leave both empty to use the profile only as a store of values.

data_description.room_sensor: The control decides only on this sensor (averaged).
data_description.ac_entity: Climate entity of the AC that gets the commands.
data_description.compressor_sensor: Optional. On while the compressor runs; used to raise the setpoint offset when the AC stops too early.
data_description.presence_entity: Optional. On/home means present. While away for longer than the set time, the AC is switched off instead of idling.
data_description.use_forecast: Hourly forecast from Open-Meteo for the Home Assistant location. Lets the control wait for sun, warmth or cooler outside air.

settings.title: Climate control: settings
settings.description: All values can be changed later. Defaults are shown.

ac_modes.name: AC modes
ac_modes.description: What the AC is set to while no heating or cooling run is needed.

data_description.active_fan_mode: Fan mode during heating and cooling runs.

start_stop.name: Start and stop
start_stop.description: When heating and cooling runs start and stop.

data_description.start_offset: A run starts this far below the minimum (heating) or above the maximum (cooling).
data_description.hard_margin: This far beyond the limit a run starts regardless of forecast and lockout.
data_description.stop_position: Auto (range) mode: where in the range a run stops. 50 % is the middle, 0 % the limit it started from.
data_description.stop_past_target: Heat or cool mode: a run stops this far past the target.
data_description.min_run: A run lasts at least this long.
data_description.min_pause: No new run starts within this time after the last change.
data_description.lockout: After heating no cooling starts within this time, and the other way round (except at the hard limit).

waiting.name: Waiting for free warmth or cooling
waiting.description: Uses the forecast for the next minutes up to the maximum waiting time.

data.fast_trend: Don't wait when changing this fast
data.warmth_margin: Warmth: outside above the minimum by
data.cool_margin: Cool air: outside below the maximum by

data_description.max_wait: Longest time to wait instead of heating or cooling. Also the length of the forecast window.
data_description.fast_trend: No waiting if the room moves this much per 30 min the wrong way.
data_description.warmth_margin: Wait instead of heating if it stays at least this much above the minimum outside the whole time.
data_description.cool_margin: Wait instead of cooling if it stays at least this much below the maximum outside the whole time.
data_description.sun_threshold: Wait instead of heating if the mean global radiation is at least this high.

offsets.name: Setpoint offset
offsets.description: The AC gets the stop point plus (heating) or minus (cooling) an offset, to make up for its own sensor.

data.raise_margin: Short of the stop point by more than
data.overshoot: Lower after overshooting by more than

data_description.auto_tune: Raise when the compressor stops too early, lower after an overshoot.
data_description.raise_idle: During a run: the compressor stood still this long while the room is short of the stop point.
data_description.raise_margin: How far the room must still be from the stop point.
data_description.overshoot: How far the room went past the stop point after a run.
data_description.overshoot_window: Time after a run in which the overshoot is measured.

manual.name: Manual changes on the AC
manual.description: A change on the AC that the control didn't send pauses the control.

data.command_grace: Ignore changes after own commands for

data_description.command_grace: The AC's reaction to a command of the control is not a manual change.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: Only used when a presence entity is set.

data.away_after: Switch the AC off after being away for

data_description.away_after: While idle and away for this long the AC is switched off instead of idling. Heating and cooling runs still happen.

measurement.name: Measurement
measurement.description: How the room sensor is evaluated.

data_description.average_window: The control uses the room temperature averaged over this time.
data_description.trend_window: Time over which the room's change is measured.

error.control_incomplete: Choose both a room temperature sensor and an air conditioner, or neither.
error.hard_below_start: The hard limit must not be smaller than the start offset.
